dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日本医師会標準レセプトソフト); likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY-based screen/linkage areas typical of ORCA architecture.
evidence: no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) software — check-master (チェックマスタ) information settings screen X01, handling drug/diagnosis check-type master maintenance
purpose.summary: This program implements the check-master information settings screen (ORCGX01/X01) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen initialization, entry processing, search, confirmation, and list printing for check-type master records linking drug codes and diagnosis codes with validity periods. It is driven by an MCP event/widget dispatch model with SPA (scratchpad area) state management.

notable_features: SPA (scratchpad area) pattern with COPY-based shared areas
24 COPY statements for modular include files
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded, garbled)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple COPY-defined areas
EVALUATE ALSO construct for multi-condition dispatch
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary MCP DB access layer
Validity period (有効期間) editing logic
verdict.notes: Comments are Japanese encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled display. Source is truncated to first 16000 chars (~26% of 60923 bytes); full program likely contains additional sections. The 'online-cics' program_type is used loosely — this is not CICS but an ORCA MCP windowing framework analogous to online transaction processing.
